name: TATA-box binding protein associated factor 15

function.text: TAF15 encodes TATA-binding protein-associated factor 2N68). Annotated molecular activities include transcription coregulator activity. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and mRNA stabilization.

germline.text: The reviewed GenCC assertions do not establish a conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship for this draft; limited or conflicting assertions require separate review.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
